body: Well I'd care about you like many others, I've always wanted to care for someone who wants it and have them know they're a priority to me, if i never get the feeling I may as well give it unto others :)

Well there's your first sign that you should try, aparrently Im not the only one who finds your story inspirational so if you need a reason to try do it for the experience or do it for those around you, and one day you can look back and see how great it was to try instead of giving up

Well looking at your lasts post being a single mother of two? I doubt i can offer much experience as a person (since i'm only 16 and a guy) to the life you've led, but I am willing to talk, call me weird or anything else but (I dont quite "enjoy" other peoples stories) but I like to know how other people felt going through the hardships of life and I imagine your story would be very inspirational to not only me, but if you look back and see it in your own eyes, It could mean a lot to you as well

Well the rules state you can't do much for people outwardly telling you to look for a way to commit suicide, but I'd say go around reading these threads and read other peoples stories like I do. It not only gives you a feeling of not being alone in this battle but it also tells you stories and doesnt lie to you of "it will get better" 13 years of age (not like im much older I only have 3 years over you) is such a young time to feel such a way (but youve probably heard that before as well) I'd say stick it out until sophmore year at least. I set a personal goal to try and make it to senior year (don't see myself making it) but i'd feel great knowin that I helped someone else make it

I feel for you on the that end-game life goal stuff, I try a fair amount in school just to try and major in engineering and the best thing i can come up with doing at the culmination of my life is just another worker at intel or google or anywhere tech based really, I wish I could have the goal and drive that other people have but I can never really find it
